# Blowhorn Tells

> Am I a Bot? A free bot-detection and browser fingerprint test at
> https://tells.blowhorn.ai/ . It inspects the visiting browser, scores what
> websites can see about it, and returns a verdict with the evidence.

## For agents

- Instructions for agents and scripts: https://tells.blowhorn.ai/agents/
  (how to drive the page with Playwright or Puppeteer, the API routes
  /api/ping, /api/check and POST /api/report, how the verdict is scored,
  and how to interpret a run.)
- The tool: https://tells.blowhorn.ai/
- Source: https://github.com/layer5io/blowhorn-tells

## Rules in one line

30 API requests per minute per route and source IP; never send real
personal data; a bot verdict for an automated browser is the tool working.
